purpose: Develop and refine a controlled-English authoring and semantic-preservation profile using real public-record cases.
design: Existing 24 source-grounded cases for development; additional meeting transcripts reserved by municipality for this iteration; deterministic action probes and semantic mutation tests scored separately.
development_label_policy: Retain prior expected labels and groups. Eleven supported positives, five negative controls, eight outside historical classifier scope. No relabeling for score improvement.
reserved_selection: Exclude all 87 previously fetched meeting keys and every municipality in the 24 development labels. For each body_type in sorted order, rank candidates by SHA256('civicspec-cce-20261010:' + k). Select up to three distinct municipalities globally. Require ts=true and thin=false. Eleven meetings selected from 249 eligible rows in the frozen index.
reserved_excerpt_selection: After freezing draft.2, choose at most two non-overlapping 13-segment windows per reserved meeting: first procedural anchor, then first finance/condition anchor at least 13 segments away. If no anchor exists, use the middle 13 segments. Record selection coverage; do not replace difficult cases.
primary_metrics: correct, incorrect, and abstaining action labels among supported positives
false action labels on negative controls
out-of-scope and unresolved cases reported separately
detected and missed injected semantic losses by field and source split
mutation_design: For each applicable populated field, modify or remove one semantic dimension in a copy of a source-anchored ledger. Mutations are synthetic errors, not observed bot errors. Keep valid copies and wording-only changes as acceptance controls. Empty/not-applicable dimensions do not receive vacuous detection credit.
freeze_policy: Hash draft.1 code/profile before round 1. Freeze development labels and round-1 outputs. Refine only using development failures. Hash draft.2 code/profile before reading reserved transcript content. Do not tune on reserved outcomes. Label corrections require separate entries.
independence: Single assistant develops code and source-grounded labels. Reserved by source/municipality for this iteration, not independently adjudicated or a blinded multi-model benchmark.
nonclaims: No causal estimate of STE prompting effectiveness
publication_basis: Public source URLs, source/selector digests and newly authored annotations only. Do not publish complete transcript/PDF archives. Preserve source access and redaction restrictions. Existing licensing status remains unchanged.
